observed_problem.description: The cohort-level snapshot reported zero total margin and notional while the protected HYPE asset row reported nonzero core-perp exposure.

root_cause.description: shared_account_facts selected only the last per-symbol reconciliation. In a profile spanning core and xyz perpetual namespaces, the last xyz snapshot cannot represent open core-perp exposure.
root_cause.affected_surface: portfolio-level telemetry and downstream exposure widgets

proposed_change.rule: Retain the freshest shared equity values and sum one margin/notional account total per unique perpetual namespace.
proposed_change.deduplication: Core BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE share one representative; xyz:SP500/SPCX share one representative.

validation.tdd_red: A controlled core-plus-xyz fixture failed because the old API accepted only the venue tuple and selected its final row.
validation.tdd_green: The same fixture reports 572 USD margin and 5972 USD notional after namespace deduplication, and mismatched symbol/snapshot input fails closed.

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: A post-restart snapshot with open core exposure still reports zero aggregate margin or notional.
Two symbols in one namespace are double-counted.
Shared equity changes because of namespace aggregation.
Any route, order, sizing, leverage, stop, or exit behavior changes.
A new perpetual namespace appears without an exact representative in the snapshot.
limitations: The corrected code is not loaded by the running backend.
The cross-namespace nonzero fixture is controlled test evidence rather than a simultaneous live core-plus-xyz position.
Live acceptance requires a flat restart and then an attributable nonzero exposure snapshot.
